name: ESPectre Wi-Fi Motion Detection
description: The `espectre` component detects motion from Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI), using the [ESPectre SDK](https://espectre.dev/sdk/). The ESP32 does all the processing, so no other motion sensor is needed.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the component ID.

config_entries.label: Csi Capture Profile
config_entries.description: `auto`, `lltf`, or `ht_vht`. Defaults to `auto`, which picks a profile for the chip, band, and traffic source. `lltf` uses the legacy long training field. `ht_vht` uses HT20 or VHT20, depending on the Wi-Fi connection.

config_entries.label: Csi Sample Spacing
config_entries.description: `half_slot` or `distinct`. Defaults to `half_slot`. Sets how close together two CSI packets can arrive and both reach the detector. `half_slot` needs at least half a time slot between them. `distinct` only needs different timestamps. Applies to every traffic source. See [Reading the Diagnostics](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#reading-the-diagnostics) for when to use `distinct`.

config_entries.label: Csi Target Pps
config_entries.description: Packets per second that the detector expects and the traffic generator sends. Range 1 to 500. Defaults to `100`. The detector splits its window into time slots of 1/`csi_target_pps` seconds. With `external` traffic, send at this rate.

config_entries.label: Csi Traffic Multicast Group
config_entries.description: Multicast group the device joins in `external` mode, to receive UDP datagrams and ICMP echo requests in addition to those sent to its own address. Defaults to `239.255.0.1`. An empty string joins no group. Requires `traffic_generator_mode: external`.

config_entries.label: Detection Algorithm
config_entries.description: `lightweight` or `high_accuracy`. Defaults to `lightweight`. Lightweight detection calibrates its threshold to the room and uses less CPU and memory. High Accuracy detection runs an on-device neural network with trained weights.

config_entries.label: Evaluation Interval
config_entries.description: Time between two detector evaluations. Range `10ms` to `10s`. Defaults to `250ms`. Motion hits count evaluations, so this also changes how long `motion_on_hits` and `motion_off_hits` take.

config_entries.label: Hampel Filter
config_entries.description: Replaces outliers with the median of the filter window. Both detection algorithms use it. Enabled by default.

config_entries.label: Enabled
config_entries.description: Whether the filter runs. Defaults to `true`.

config_entries.label: Threshold
config_entries.description: A sample is replaced when its distance from the median is more than this value times 1.4826 times the median absolute deviation (MAD). Range 1.0 to 10.0. Defaults to `5.0`.

config_entries.label: Window
config_entries.description: Window length, in samples. Range 3 to 11. Defaults to `7`.

config_entries.label: Lowpass Filter
config_entries.description: Smooths the signal before the detector evaluates it. This can reduce false positives, but slows the response. Disabled by default.

config_entries.label: Cutoff
config_entries.description: Cutoff frequency. Range `5Hz` to `20Hz`. Defaults to `11Hz`. The filter assumes 100 samples per second. With a different `csi_target_pps`, or with many missing slots, the real cutoff is different.

config_entries.label: Enabled
config_entries.description: Whether the filter runs. Defaults to `true` when the block is present.

config_entries.label: Motion Off Hits
config_entries.description: How many detector evaluations in a row must be below the threshold to clear motion. Range 1 to 20. Defaults to `3`.

config_entries.label: Motion On Hits
config_entries.description: How many detector evaluations in a row must be above the threshold to report motion. Range 1 to 20. Defaults to `4`, about 1 second at the default `evaluation_interval`. Raise it if short bursts trigger motion. Lower it if motion is reported too late.

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Mode
config_entries.description: The source of the traffic that carries CSI: `ping`, `dns`, `dns_tcp`, `wifi_raw`, or `external`. Defaults to `ping`. See [Traffic Sources](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#traffic-sources).

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Target IP
config_entries.description: Where `ping`, `dns`, and `dns_tcp` send their traffic. Defaults to the Wi-Fi gateway. Use a unicast address that answers the selected mode. DNS modes need a DNS server on port 53, with TCP support for `dns_tcp`. Cannot be used with `wifi_raw` or `external`.

config_entries.label: Traffic Generator Target MAC
config_entries.description: Where `wifi_raw` sends its Null Data frames. Defaults to the access point the device is connected to, also after roaming. Set it to the Wi-Fi station MAC address of another ESPectre device in `external` mode to measure the link between the two devices. See [Two-Device Sensing](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#two-device-sensing). Must be a unicast address. With the device's own address, raw traffic does not start. The option applies whenever `wifi_raw` runs, also after the [traffic source select](https://esphome.io/components/espectre/#selects) switches to it. Not available on ESP32-C6 or with `csi_capture_profile: ht_vht`.

config_entries.label: Window Size
config_entries.description: Length of the detector window. Range `1000ms` to `2000ms`. Defaults to `1000ms`. A longer window changes the detector features and the response time.
